CvRain/NandinaUI.description: A simple native desktop UI framework
CvRain/NandinaUI.body:
# NandinaUI · 南天竹

**A C++26 GUI framework for Linux desktops — making desktop application development a pleasant experience.**

## Introduction

NandinaUI (南天竹) is a native desktop UI framework written in **C++26** and built with **Meson**. Built on C++ widgets and a scene tree, it provides declarative interface construction, reactive state, theming, animation, resource management, and page navigation. It lets application code organize desktop interfaces with a type-safe DSL while retaining the ability to directly access widget objects.

During development, the project drew on design ideas from existing mainstream frameworks, such as the page scheduling and reactive mechanisms of `Angular`, the primitives + token component design of `Shadcn`, the dirty-data update and file rendering mechanisms of `Slint`, and the new signal-slot mechanism and component API design of `Qt`.

> Currently in **alpha** stage. The officially supported scope is the `linux-desktop-source` profile (Linux desktop source integration). The API is still evolving rapidly; the project does not guarantee preservation of old public header files or namespace source-compatibility entry points.

## Project at a Glance

| Item | Information |
| --- | --- |
| Positioning | Native C++ UI framework for Linux desktop applications |
| Language / Standard | C++, `cpp_std=c++26` |
| Build system | Meson (third-party libraries adapted via CMake subproject) |
| License | MIT (Copyright © 2026 ClaudeRainer) |
| Version | 0.1.0-alpha.1 |

## ✨ Core Features

- **Declarative UI DSL** — Compose readable interface trees with `ui.column()`, `ui.center()`, `ui.make<widget::Button>()`; layout, alignment, and spacing are all completed in a single chain.
- **Reactive state** — `signal` / `computed` / `effect` / `property` / `batch`; state changes automatically drive UI updates, no more manual refreshing.
- **Composable component library** — Covers content display, input and selection, layout and scrolling, overlay feedback, and general pointer gestures, combined through a unified theme and declarative builders.
- **Animation system** — Value-level Tween, Spring, keyframes, and easing curves; the node presentation layer supports L2 property animations such as opacity, translate, and scale, and a flat Tween composition on the same node provides an experimental author entry point. Cross-node composition, in-group Spring, and keyframe author entry points are not yet open.
- **Modern text engine** — A glyph pipeline composed of FreeType + HarfBuzz + FriBidi + utf8proc, supporting multiple fonts, system font discovery, complex text shaping, and bidirectional text.
- **Theme and design system**…

Krysta1ll/Meowpuut.body:
Meowpuut can type Zhuyin (注音) and Pinyin, and output Traditional or Simplified characters. On first use, the input method and character forms default based on your system language and region. You can change them later in Settings.

「中日混打」(Mixed Chinese-Japanese typing) is a toggle that is off by default on new installs. When it's on, if you want to put a Japanese word in the middle of Chinese typing, just type it in romaji. For example, type `sushi`, and the candidate with a cat paw, 「寿司」, is the Japanese word. The toggle is in 「鍵盤設定」(Keyboard Settings) in the Meowpuut app on iPhone, on the 「試打」(Trial Typing) page of Meowpuut settings on Mac, and in the settings on Android and Windows. People who were already using it keep it as it was after upgrading (on), and can turn it off themselves. English is not affected by this toggle. It still gets typed directly inside Pinyin: `wozaiyongiphone` is 「我在用iPhone」.

The candidate bar is a piece of glass. The black Mimimo and the cream-colored Momo rest their front paws on it.

It is mainly a keyboard for iPhone and iPad, and it is also available for Mac, Android, and Windows. Versions and installation methods for each platform are listed below.

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

**A public-document tool that puts Korean documents in AI's hands.** Read, create, and check documents right where they are, with just a sentence.

- Give it a received official letter and say “draft a reply,” and you get a Hangul file (HWPX) in your agency's format.

# File & Link Actions · File Actions

**Code references travel with their source. Right-click delivered files to keep working on them.**

[English](https://github.com/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-file-actions/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) · [npm · 0.1.23](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jidekaixin2dian/dsh-file-actions/v/0.1.23) · [Plugin Marketplace](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-file-actions/) · [Download](https://github.com/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-file-actions/releases/latest) · [Changelog](https://github.com/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-file-actions/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md)

File Actions provides a right-click menu for file references in DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Start from a code line number, a delivery card, or an image to view context, choose an app, preview, locate, and copy directly.

| What you want to do next | What File Actions provides |
|---|---|
| See the code the Agent referenced | Read-only preview of the referenced lines and surrounding lines, highlighting the referenced range |
| Hand the reference to someone or another session | Copy the reference text, file path, and line number in one step |
| Keep editing delivered files | Search “Open with” and remember the preferred app for each file type |
| Look at images and videos first | Menu thumbnails, image enlargement, and browser preview for supported formats |

## View context, and take the source along

Right-click `src/app.ts:42:7` or `notes.md#L42-L48` and choose “View reference context”. Once you understand it, use “Copy snippet and source” to take the referenced lines, relative path, and line numbers; or copy only the referenced lines.

# AstrBot Memora Connect

**A hippocampus-mimicking AI memory plugin that gives chatbots persistent memory**

---

## Project Overview

Memora Connect gives AstrBot human-like memory. The LLM automatically extracts memories, people, places, and relationships from conversations and writes them into a single SQLite database (partitioned by chat). Before each LLM request, it recalls relevant memories by relevance and injects them.

```
Conversation → idle/threshold-triggered LLM analysis → memories/entities/relations/impressions UPSERT into database
                                            ↓
LLM request → keyword + graph association (+ semantic vectors) three-way recall fusion → context injection
```

## Core Capabilities

| | |
|---|---|
| 🧠 Memory formation | After 60s of idle time or once a threshold number of messages accumulates, a single LLM call batch-analyzes the session, producing memories, entities, relations, and impressions |
| 🔍 Three-way recall | Keyword (FTS5 trigram) · graph association (entity inverted index + adjacency) · semantic vectors (optional, requires an embedding provider) |
| 🌐 Knowledge graph | Entity nodes + edges with semantic relations, each edge extracted by the LLM |
| 👤 Impression system | Each person has an independent affinity score and summary, separate from memory strength |
| 👥 Group chat isolation | Each group or private chat has its own memory space (scope_id), without interference |

## Quick Start

| Command | Function |
|---|---|
| `/记忆 回忆 [关键词]` | Manually recall relevant memories |
| `/记忆 状态` | View memory database statistics |
| `/记忆 印象 [人名]` | Query the impression of a person |
| `/记忆 图谱 [布局]` | Visualize the knowledge graph (requires optional dependencies matplotlib/networkx) |

The LLM also automatically calls five tools: `create_memory`, `recall_memory`, `delete_memory`, `adjust_impression`, and `record_impression`.

## Key Configuration

- `recall_weight_keyword / semantic / graph`: recall weights, adjustable and automatically normalized.
- `group_chat_memory_mode`: scope of group chat memory collection (at_only: only messages that @ the bot; all: collect all group messages).
- `enable_embedding_recall`: enables semantic recall (requires an embedding provider available in AstrBot).
- `formation_idle_flush_seconds` / `topic_message_threshold`: timing for when session analysis is triggered.
- `memory_injection_threshold`: minimum relevance for injection into context. …

wtyLaziness/desksend.description: Windows keyboard and mouse sharing with bidirectional cross-screen file transfer, supporting multi-machine drag-and-drop, transfer progress, and configuration-preserving updates. Integrates Deskflow and LocalSend.
wtyLaziness/desksend.body:
DeskSend integrates the keyboard and mouse sharing of [Deskflow](https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow) and the LAN file transfer of [LocalSend](https://github.com/localsend/localsend) in a single portable package. After running DeskSend on both machines, you can use the host's keyboard and mouse to operate the secondary machine, and drag files or folders across the screen edge to send them, without separately installing or starting LocalSend.

## What it can do

| Capability | How to use |
| --- | --- |
| Cross-screen keyboard and mouse sharing | Arrange the host and secondary screens to match their actual positions; moving the mouse past an edge switches control to the other computer. |
| Bidirectional file dragging | Supports host → secondary and secondary → host; both use the mouse shared by the host to drag, and source files are kept. |
| Multi-machine delivery | After multiple secondary machines connect to the same host, you can drag a file from secondary A across the host screen and drop it on secondary B; the file is sent directly from the source computer to the final receiving computer. |
| Drag and transfer feedback | After entering the target screen, a drop-to-receive prompt appears beside the cursor; after dropping, it shows preparing to receive, transfer progress, and the result. |
| Save by drop location | The receiver's desktop or Explorer folder can serve as the drop location; other windows fall back to the default receive directory, and a file clipboard is provided for pasting with `Ctrl+V`. |
| Configuration-preserving updates | The built-in updater downloads and verifies the full package, backs up the programs to be overwritten, and keeps the configuration, certificates, and pairings in `settings/`. |

## Quick start

### 1. Download the full package

Download `DeskSend-<version>-windows-x64.zip` from the [latest release page](https://github.com/wtyLaziness/desksend-releases/releases/latest). Use the same version on both computers, fully extract it to a writable directory, and run `DeskSend.exe`.

Do not run it directly from the archive preview, and do not copy only the EXE. Keep `deskflow-core.exe`, `localsend-cli.exe`, the Qt DLLs, plugins, and `translations/` in the same directory. `DeskSend-<version>-source.zip` is the source code archive, not a runnable package.

### 2. Connect the host and secondary machines

Both computers need to be on a LAN where they can reach each other:

1. **Host (Server, connected to the physical keyboard and mouse)**: select “Use this computer's keyboard and mouse”, open “Configure server”, add the secondary machine and place it according to its actual position. The screen name must match the computer name shown on the secondary machine, then start.
2. **Secondary (Client)**: select “Use another computer's mouse and keyboard”, enter the host's LAN IP address, and start. Do not enter `127.0.0.1`.
3. On the first TLS connection, when the certificate fingerprint confirmation appears, verify it and trust it, then move the mouse across the configured edge to check cross-screen operation.

---

## 🌟 Project Highlights

### ✨ Core Features

# 115 Media Hub

`115 Media Hub` is a media automation management panel based on FastAPI. It brings cloud drive transfers, 115 cloud drive `.strm` generation, movie and TV subscription tracking, file management, and cross-drive copying into one backend, so that Jellyfin / Emby / Plex can play the films stored on cloud drives directly.

It suits self-hosted setups of the form "movies stored on 115, series tracked through subscriptions, media libraries handled by Jellyfin/Emby/Plex". For anyone who doesn't want a cloud drive client and doesn't want to move files by hand, it is the least effort.

> **This project is free and open source under the MIT License. All features can be used directly. There is no paid version, and no license needs to be purchased.** If you see terms such as "Pro edition", "license key", or "activation" elsewhere, they are not offered by this project.

## Feature Overview

| Module | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Resource Center | Sync TG public channels, connect PanSou disk search, manually paste resources. Supports importing magnet / ED2K / direct links and share links from each cloud drive |
| Movie & TV Subscription Tasks | Automatically find resources by name for movies and series and import them. Supports scheduled runs, score thresholds, quality preferences, TMDB binding and tracking, and per-season subscriptions |
| Folder Monitoring Tasks | Scan cloud drive directories to generate or sync `.strm`. Supports manual, scheduled, and Webhook triggers, plus partial refresh. Scans only, does not organize |
| Inbox | A transit folder before classification. Magnet, transfer, and manual saves are dropped here first, then the media type is identified automatically and the files are moved into the matching category directory |
| Directory Tree Tasks | Calls the official "export directory tree" API and incrementally updates `.strm` by sha1. Supports full rewrite. Suited to building large libraries in one pass |
| File Management | Browse cloud drives, copy / move / rename / delete, **cross-drive copy**, TMDB recognition binding, batch rename and scraping |
| Seerr On-Demand | Treats the panel as Radarr / Sonarr. Family members click once in Seerr and a subscription task is created automatically. The Emby compatibility bridge lets Seerr reuse the 极影视 library index |
| Command Line (CLI) | Host command-line client. Completes search / subscribe / transfer / monitor / scrape / STRM through the panel API |
| WeCom Notifications | Pushes events such as subscription success, monitoring generation, and cross-drive copy. Bot and app channels are both supported, and each event can be toggled independently |
| 115 Daily Check-in | Manual or scheduled check-in. Status is shown at the top of the page |

**Supported cloud drives**: `115` / `Quark` / `Tianyi Cloud` / `123 Cloud Drive` / `Alibaba Cloud Drive`. # go-zero-admin

An admin backend built on **go-zero + React**. It includes permission, department, file, audit, and APP user management, plus AI chat, knowledge base retrieval, and approval workflows, and is suitable as a development starting point for business systems.

The backend uses **1 HTTP API + 5 RPC services** (admin / app / file / ai / tenant). The frontend uses React 19, TypeScript, and Ant Design 6.

CI automatically runs the backend `verify.ps1`, plus frontend type checking and build. Results are shown in the status badges above.

## Features

| Module | Features |
|---|---|
| Workbench | Statistics within the current department and authorized scope, recent operations, and frequently used entries |
| System management | Users, roles, menus, departments, dictionaries, API resources, files, audit, and personal center |
| Permission control | JWT, Casbin, department identity, and data scope; page access and operation permissions are authorized separately |
| APP management | User profiles and review, avatars, login devices, membership activation/revocation, and feedback replies |
| AI chat | SSE streaming replies, session search/rename/pin, message rating, Markdown export, and knowledge base sources |
| Knowledge base / RAG | Material workspace, TXT/Markdown backend import, original text versions, source-backed analysis, and export of ratings, reviews, and regression samples |
| Common workflows | One-step analysis templates, unsaved trial runs, multi-step flows and approvals, with version conflict protection, history viewing, and restore as a new version |
| Run records | Single analysis runs and workflow runs are stored together, showing actual inputs, results, and sources, with support for approval, cancellation, and comparison of two terminal runs |
| Usage and quotas | Aggregates known/unknown usage for chat, analysis, and Embedding; manages per-user daily request quotas, full-stack provider concurrency, and known-token alerts |
| Tools and capabilities | Select capabilities by Chinese-language purpose, view input/output examples and configuration status, and use them in workflows |
| Tenant management | List, status filtering, read-only details, and tenant lifecycle HTTP/RPC interfaces |

The APP side has separate authentication, profile, membership, and feedback interfaces. Tenant runtime stacks must be created and configured separately. The initialization database does not include fictitious runtime stacks or tenant credentials.

## Quick Start

Prepare **Go 1.27.3, PowerShell, Docker (Linux containers) with Compose, Node.js 24, and pnpm 11.28.5**.

Open PowerShell in the repository root and start the backend:

```powershell
cd go-zero-admin
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath .env.local)) { Copy-Item .env.local.example .env.local }
# Edit .env.local as needed and fill in an AI Key, or SMTP email and authorization code
powershell…
```
